## Description

Alsona is a signal-driven outbound sales platform that uses AI agents to find in-market buyers and turn their buying signals into personalised LinkedIn and email outreach.

It tracks more than 30 signals, including hiring, funding, review sites, news, podcasts and LinkedIn comments, then matches each signal to your ideal customer profile and scores it so weak leads do not reach your queue. [...] ## Alsona Key Features

 Tracks 30+ buying signals including hiring, funding, podcasts and LinkedIn comments
 Scores prospects on intent signals and fit with your ideal customer profile
 AI-written outreach across LinkedIn DMs, InMail and email
 Multi-sender rotation spreads volume across several LinkedIn and email accounts
 Unified inbox threads every LinkedIn and email reply per prospect
 Integrates with HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, HighLevel, Close, Clay and Zapier
 Approval mode holds every AI message until you approve, edit or reject it

## Alsona Pricing

Every plan has a 7-day free trial. Starter costs $99 per month for 500 high-intent prospects, Pro $149 per month for 2,500, and Ultra $499 per month for 10,000 with unlimited active agents. [...] ## Related AI guides

## What is Alsona

Alsona is an intent signal platform for B2B sales. You give it your ideal customer profile and the signals that matter to you, and it keeps surfacing decision-makers who are showing intent right now. Every record shows the signals behind it and a score weighing fit against intent, so you know why a prospect surfaced before you act on it. The problem it solves is timing: reaching people when they're actually in-market instead of working cold lists.
